item: Are constitutions static? (other countries rewrite; India has one Constitution since 1950)

item: Special majority (half of total strength AND two-thirds of those voting; no joint sitting; President cannot return the Bill)

item: Contents of amendments: technical; differing interpretations; political consensus; controversial (38th, 39th, 42nd; 43rd and 44th reversed)
why_it_must_be_taught: Gives the four groups; the third and fourth groups lead to the doctrine

item: Basic structure and evolution of the Constitution (3 effects of Kesavananda)

item: Review of the Constitution (Venkatachaliah Commission 2000 respected basic structure)

item: Conclusion: debates about what is basic structure are normal

item: Conflict with judiciary 1970-75 and the Emergency amendments (Class XII)
why_it_must_be_taught: Class XII's short account; Emergency detail belongs to POL-07

item: Constituent power versus ordinary law-making power (amendment is not 'law' under Art. 13?)

item: Flexible versus rigid constitution; India combines both
why_it_must_be_taught: Core NCERT concept; also PSIR

item: Sovereignty of elected representatives as the basis of the amendment procedure; Ambedkar's reasoning on two-thirds

why_it_must_be_taught: Part of 'living document'; careful with wording 'judiciary amended the Constitution'

item: Rule of law and checks on arbitrary power: why 'pro-people' reasons do not bypass procedure

why_it_must_be_taught: Names 'amendments' and 'basic structure' directly

item: 'Parliamentary System and Amendment Procedures; Judicial Review and Basic Structure doctrine' (PSIR Paper I, Indian Government and Politics, item 3)
why_it_must_be_taught: Names 'Amendment Procedures', 'Judicial Review' and 'Basic Structure doctrine'

item: Amendment (term to define and use consistently)
why_it_must_be_taught: D2 gate: term kept

why_it_must_be_taught: Learner must meet the synonyms and see they are not a fixed list

why_it_must_be_taught: Used in PSIR line; link to Art. 13, 32, 226

why_it_must_be_taught: Technical words a topper uses

why_it_must_be_taught: Living fact; date it

why_it_must_be_taught: Operating rule today

why_it_must_be_taught: Careful: negative claim not proved
